definitions.explanation: Used to add additional information or emphasis to what has already been stated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。そのうえ、⟦スポーツ→スポーツ：04740_supootsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: He is smart. Moreover, he is good at sports too.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}っていた→降る：00839_furu⟧。そのうえ、⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{強|つよ}かった→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: It was raining. On top of that, the wind was strong.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。そのうえ、⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: The food is delicious. Furthermore, the prices are cheap.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧。そのうえ、⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{開|あ}いている→開く：00689_aku⟧。
examples.english: This store is close to the station. Moreover, it's open until late at night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。そのうえ、⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{会|あ}えない→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: She is busy with work. Furthermore, she also goes to school on weekends, so we can rarely meet.

notes:
そのうえ is used to add information that reinforces or builds upon the previous statement.

USAGE:
- Usually placed at the beginning of a sentence
- Adds information in the same direction (positive + positive, or negative + negative)
- Often emphasizes that something is even better/worse than expected

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦しかも→しかも：03818_shikamo⟧: moreover (similar, slightly more emphatic)
- ⟦さらに→更に：03817_sarani⟧: furthermore (more formal)
- ⟦おまけに→おまけに：21779_omakeni⟧: on top of that (often for unexpected additions)
- ⟦それに→それに：01806_soreni⟧: besides, in addition (casual)

WRITING:
- Can also be written as {其|そ}の{上|うえ} in formal writing
- その{上|うえ} with partial kanji is also common
